findings.currentPlan: Omgevingsplan Groningen CVDR696162 remains the spatial/address layer.
findings.currentHousingRules: Huisvestingsverordening 2025 is current from 20-05-2025 and Beleidsregels huisvestingsverordening 2025 are current from 05-06-2025.
findings.roomRental: For conversion to room rental an omzettingsvergunning is required; new permits are issued only in very high-exception situations. Environment/liveability and housing-market need are assessed. Owner of a room-rental property also needs a person-bound verhuurvergunning. At 5+ rooms sharper fire-safety requirements and a use notification apply.
findings.splitting: For cadastral splitting of a dwelling 15 years or older a splitsingsvergunning is required. Building conversion can additionally require woningvormingsvergunning and omgevingsvergunning.
splittingDocuments: one or more construction drawings scale 1:100 showing division/property changes/index numbers, including outdoor spaces
recognised-taxator report on building and individual dwellings including maintenance condition
findings.splittingFees: 2026 splitsingsvergunning EUR 325.72 per resulting apartment; woningvormingsvergunning EUR 3,212.33.
findings.splittingTerm: Both splitsingsvergunning and woningvormingsvergunning max 8 weeks, extendable 6 weeks.
findings.scope: VvE/private-law restrictions are not treated as municipal permission law; user project scope can exclude VvE while municipal permit requirements remain.

remainingAllowedOnly: concrete address environment test/current Omgevingsplan outcome
omgevingsvergunning technical/spatial documents generated for actual project
exception-specific evidence for rare new room-rental conversion
